items.q: Is the first call really free?
items.a: Yes: a free 30-minute introductory phone call, with no obligation, to get to know each other and clarify your needs.

items.q: Can the skills assessment be funded?
items.a: The assessment is carried out in partnership with Orientaction. Funding options are discussed together during our first conversation.
Both are possible, whichever is the most practical and comfortable for you.

meta.title: About
meta.description: Maréva Ors, career-evolution counsellor. From biotech to coaching: my journey, my values and the way I support people.

hero.title: To support is, first of all, to listen.
hero.lead: I'm Maréva Ors, a career-evolution counsellor. I support those looking to give new meaning to their working life.

parcours.title: My journey
parcours.text: From biotechnology research to my own experience of job-hunting, I turned that experience into a profession: career-evolution counsellor. A “professional job seeker” for a while, I now support people in search of meaning.

cards.title: Kindness & humanity
